notes.title: "Single By Choice" is now available for a limited time DEMO!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/8251f6eb0a1ee380cf609d3e03bad1501a78be32.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2812180/Single_By_Choice/
You've inherited your family's super-strong pheromones, and now all the girls are after you... Too bad you want to stay a virgin! Now quick, run for your life or lose your chastity... forever!

From May 3rd, a two-week limited-time trial will be available, allowing players to experience levels and two events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923215/ad22b1c8645232df2863e27e89826a4f658328bf.png[/img]
[h1]—Game Mechanics—[/h1]
[list]
[*] Time-limited Escapes: Get away from your female pursuers before time runs out so you can save yourself for true love! Be careful, because if you’re caught even once, there's no getting that chastity back!
[*] Collectibles: Girls just get in the way of gaming time, amiright!? Collect all the consoles you can find so you can stay a virgin gamer... forever!
[*] Unlockable Scenes: Use the coins you get from completing levels to unlock special story content.
[/list]
[h1]【Warning】[/h1]
All character depicted are over the age of 18.
This game adult content including :
-Full nudity
-Sexual scenes
-Sexual assault/non-consensual sex
please make sure you are in the right place to avoid any unnecessary attention.

notes.title: "Beyond the Curtains" - Cozy Game Condensing the Stories of Townsfolk
notes.content:
[h2]A Serene Story through the Window[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/04c81e510aae8a0e3cdf77dfaa950ffdbe94c1b9.gif[/img]
Forget the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil story unfolding beyond the window. Leisurely observe the landscapes and passing people through the window, capturing moments of soothing tranquility.


[h2]Poetry of Objects[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/20d0e62fce455718faeab30038d7f09cfa8d3d77.gif[/img]
Feeling the owner's profound emotions story through the evolving objects in the room.


[h2]Enjoy at Your Own Pace[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/09dcd9d86538d019a27d52b415639ff54a10e4d2.gif[/img]
Liberate yourself from stress and pressure, taking control of the game's progression at your own pace. With no fear of missing anything, you can savor a delightful healing time.

[h2]Add to Wishlist[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648940

notes.title: Full achievement unlock & update progress
notes.content:
Hello players:

(網頁上可以看到中文版。天啊，為什麼steam控制器上都放這破英文...)
There are already players in the discussion area put the whole way of unlocking.
But also intimate with a description of the document, want to collect all the achievements of the players may be able to see the past ... ...

So far, we have recieved a few questions:

1. The font is not uniform.
This is a problem with the application not correctly reading the font, we expect to have this amended within several days.
This has greatly affected the player's reading experience, so we hope to deal with this as soon as possible.

2. Typo problems.
If you find typos, please tell us and we will correct them in an update (especially in some of the words we are not familiar with).
Please leave a message in the forums, thank you very much for your assistance.
This time we have invited the mainland friends draft, but may be arranged in the layout and omissions.
Please forgive me.

3. Will there be dubbing?
Because there are some localizations in the text, there are some differences between the two versions.
Plus the current group of dubbing members are busy with a new work, so this game will not have dubbing.
But we hope that our future works will include dubbing.
After 2016 we have a voice group!

4. Is the theme song original? Will it be sold separately?
Yes, the theme song is original.
About seperate sale, we are confirming the copyright...

5. Full screen mode may crash.
This game does not support full screen mode for dual monitors.
If you are not using dual monitors and are still encountering this problem, please inform us.

6. The style is very different from Koi musubi !?
We try all sorts of styles.
This game was produced four years ago, since then we have made a variety of attempts.
Today we are still writing new works.
In the future, perhaps everyone will find the common and different elements of our work.
But if you do not like the style of this work compared to our others, please leave your most realistic evaluation.
This can avoid other players with the same preferences falling into the same pit!
A carrot or a radish, different players like diferent styles.
As long as we get constructive comments, for us they are very valuable.

But anyway ... ... today called back to the company for overtime (there are other duties).
For a while we will be replying and dealing with issues more slowly, sorry.
